newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends higher in last session of 1996.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends higher in last session of 1996.

text.p: IPE Brent and gas oil futures closed slightly higher on Tuesday in the exchange's last session of 1996
February Brent settled 12 cents higher at $23.81 a barrel, while January gas oil settled 75 cents up at $223.75 a tonne.
Brokers said volume had been very thin and very little had been done.
"It's very quiet," one broker said. "We've seen about 4,500 lots in the two pits combined. That's nothing."
Brokers said severe cold weather across Europe continued to buoy both gas oil and Brent.
"We'll have to see what the weather does over the break," said one broker. "But if the cold weather continues we could start 1997 with a bang."
The exchange, which closed at 1230 GMT for the New Year holiday break, will be shut on Thursday and reopen for business as usual on Thursday.
